### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **153** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **153**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **98** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3bd28e2b2ea81206dc9f5507de205b564bd97097` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `046d124d58598a18b163fc774d592a7ba0ae3bf9` — the merge of head `25b0853862dbc8e5e82b992b677048630f2b518e` into base `3bd28e2b2ea81206dc9f5507de205b564bd97097`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 046d124d58598a18b163fc774d592a7ba0ae3bf9 && git checkout 046d124d58598a18b163fc774d592a7ba0ae3bf9
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 3bd28e2b2ea81206dc9f5507de205b564bd97097 25b0853862dbc8e5e82b992b677048630f2b518e && git checkout -B drift-repro 3bd28e2b2ea81206dc9f5507de205b564bd97097 && git merge --no-ff 25b0853862dbc8e5e82b992b677048630f2b518e

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3bd28e2b2ea81206dc9f5507de205b564bd97097
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `25b0853862dbc8e5e82b992b677048630f2b518e`

<sub>Read: card #20126 body + all 3 comments; PR #20179 object, body, 9-file list, API diff (equal to `git diff e2c4e125f..25b085386` modulo index lines), 3 commits, 35 check-runs on the head; at the head via `refs/pr-review/20179`: field.zod.ts (:420-:510, :1040-:1070, :2290-:2320), field-value.zod.ts, currency-fraction-digits.ts, execution-context.zod.ts, assemble-execution-context.ts, localization.manifest.ts, service-analytics plugin.ts / analytics-service.ts / strategies / 3 test files, rest-server.ts + runtime domains/analytics.ts routes, ADR-0104, ADR-0053, AGENTS.md changeset rules, ci.yml / lint.yml / pack-smoke-optin.yml job conditions, and re-derived both pin censuses at base and head with git grep + awk; objectui read through an anonymous shallow git clone (REST is 403 for it here) at HEAD f308a655, the cited a2f361b and the pinned f8a9d0fb. NOT MEASURED: no derived gate, build or test was run locally; the vendored Console was not booted; the pin censuses are my own line-window scripts, not the card's future test.</sub>

### ① Derived judgments

**Changed sentences, each judged against the runtime at the head.**

- **Spec `.describe()` (field.zod.ts:439), one line, one string.** TRUE. Every reader of `currencyMode` / `defaultCurrency` outside tests reads `defaultCurrency` only under `'fixed'`: field.zod.ts:457 (`if (config.precision === undefined || config.currencyMode !== 'fixed') return;`), field.zod.ts:2310 (field-level `precision` twin), plugin.ts:1101-1104 (`fixedCurrency = f.currencyConfig?.currencyMode === 'fixed' ? f.currencyConfig.defaultCurrency : undefined`), analytics-service.ts:1811 (`mc.currency ?? meta?.defaultCurrency ?? context?.currency`, where `meta.defaultCurrency` is the plugin's fixed-only relay). "Tenant default currency (the `localization.currency` setting; a plain number when none is set)": execution-context.zod.ts:104-110 (`currency` resolved from the `localization` settings, "Undefined when no tenant default is configured — consumers then render a plain number"), assemble-execution-context.ts:368 (`currency: anonymous ? undefined : localization?.currency`), localization.manifest.ts:123-129 (key `currency`, "Leave unset to render code-less amounts as plain numbers"). "Neither mode is a per-record choice: the value is a bare number either way": field-value.zod.ts:63-65 (`currency` in the finite-numeric-scalar set), ADR-0104 Context + D1. ADR-0053 (`0053-date-and-datetime-semantics.md`) contains no occurrence of `currenc`. objectui's `resolveFieldCurrency` (packages/i18n/src/currency.ts at objectui main f308a655 and at the cited a2f361b, which exists on objectui main 9 commits behind HEAD and after fix commit ea9d17f = objectui#10461, 2026-09-25): `(config?.currencyMode === 'fixed' ? config.defaultCurrency : undefined)`, returns `undefined` when nothing is known "so the renderer shows a plain number". The old phrase "user selectable" survives at the head only inside the changeset that quotes it.
- **Regenerated reference rows (field.mdx:31, :239).** TRUE and byte-identical to the describe (programmatic comparison: both rows MATCH). `check:docs` (`build-docs.ts --check`) runs in lint.yml job `typecheck-source-gates` = check-run "Type Check · source gates", success.
- **data-api.mdx:464-476.** TRUE. `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` (rest-server.ts:11619) requires and calls `svc.queryDataset`; `queryDataset` runs `enrichResultColumns` (analytics-service.ts:1434 preview, :1691 live), which holds the chain at :1798-:1812. `POST /analytics/query` → `analyticsService.query` (runtime domains/analytics.ts:126) → strategy result, whose `buildFieldMeta` pushes only `{ name, type }` (native-sql-strategy.ts:1242-1257, objectql-strategy.ts:1955-1967); `query()` (:1281-:1386) mentions no currency; `currency-mode-relay.test.ts:236-259` pins that no cube column carries `currency`. "if one is set" matches the `undefined` ctx.currency path.
- **validation-rules.mdx:155, :156, :158.** TRUE. :155's precision fact is field.zod.ts:457-461 (authored `precision` vs `currencyPrecisionContradiction(defaultCurrency, precision)`, ISO 4217 / CLDR, only under `fixed`). Nit, not false: that check fails open for non-CLDR codes, which the next row admits ("or crypto"); the sentence is scoped to "ISO 4217 fraction digits".
- **types.mdx:297 (YAML comment) and :306-:314 (callout).** TRUE, same readers as above.
- **service-analytics text.** preview-column-enrichment.test.ts: header row :51, two `it` titles :282/:288, one comment :290; query-dataset.test.ts: section comment :125-:128. The fixture supports the new titles: `sourceFieldMeta` (:165-:168) returns `{ type: 'currency', defaultCurrency: 'EUR' }` for `amount` and `{ type: 'currency' }` for `fee`; `CTX.currency` is `'USD'` (:179). The query-dataset comment describes the plugin relay, plugin.ts:1101-1104, correctly.
- **Changeset prose.** TRUE: "field faces" = objectui main resolver; "analytics dataset measure columns" = plugin/service above; "publish-time precision check" = the superRefine whose own comment calls it "a publish-time error" (field.zod.ts:445-447); "keys, values, defaults (`dynamic`, `CNY`) and parse output are the same" = the diff touches one describe string.

**Examples whose behaviour changed.** common-patterns.mdx:53 and :82 add `currencyMode: 'fixed'` to the `budget` field. At base the example's `defaultCurrency: 'USD'` was inert (a mode-less config is `dynamic`; the tenant currency displayed). The surrounding prose (:25-:27, "Define a basic object with common fields for create, read, update, and delete operations", "complete, copy-pasteable example") makes no claim about the budget's currency, so the example now shows what its own text declares and contradicts nothing. types.mdx:297 gains a comment only; the block already carried `currencyMode: fixed` at :296.

**Accept set / defaults / parse output / export surface.** Unchanged: the only non-doc, non-test source change is the describe string on field.zod.ts:439 (1 line, +1/-1); no schema shape, `.default()`, `.overwrite()`, alias table or export moved; `authorable-surface*.json` and `authorable-defaults` untouched; Lint & Repo Gates (carries `check:api-surface` / `check:authorable-surface`) success.

**Assertions in service-analytics tests.** None changed: the diff to the two test files touches only comment lines and two `it(...)` title strings; every `expect(` line is context, not a change.

**Census, re-derived.** Hand-written `defaultCurrency` lines under `content/docs/**/*.mdx` minus `releases/` and the generated `references/`: 13 at merge-base e2c4e125f and the same 13 at the body's base 84880f9 (field-types 3, fields 4, validation-rules 1, common-patterns 2, types 3), of which 5 fail the card's line rule (validation-rules:156, common-patterns:53/:82, types:297/:308) — the PR changes all 5 and lists all 13 with the same verdicts (types:315 is :318 at the head, unchanged). At the head, all 26 `defaultCurrency` lines (including the generated rows and data-api.mdx:472/:474) carry `fixed`: 0 failing. Lines the PR neither changed nor listed that fail the pin: none. `ADR-0053` within five lines of `currenc` over `skills/**`, `content/docs/**`, `service-analytics/src/**`: base 6 (data-api:467, preview-column-enrichment:51/:282/:288, query-dataset:125, dashboards.md:308), head 1 (dashboards.md:308, the Tier H remainder). The body's table and pin readings match.

**Untouched surfaces.** `git diff --stat e2c4e125f..25b085386 -- skills/ content/docs/releases/` is empty. The merge commit brought nothing into the 9 PR files (`git diff c0f1faf22..25b085386` on those paths is empty).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/20126-currency-mode-describe.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, `Clause-②: no`. Correct: the only published-package change is a `.describe()` string, nothing authorable is removed or renamed (AGENTS.md:1071-1075: `no` needs no arm; `yes` would need at least `minor`), so `patch` is the right level and `no` the right arm. `content/docs/**` is not a package; the service-analytics edits are test text only, so nothing else publishes and no other changeset is owed. The PR body's `Clause-②: no` (line 2) matches the diff and the changeset. Check-run "Check Changeset": success.

### ③ Boundary flags
Blocking: none
Non-blocking: (1) The vendored Console pin `.objectui-sha` = f8a9d0fb (2026-09-24, unchanged on origin/main 455dcc06) predates objectui fix ea9d17f (#10461, 2026-09-25): at that pin `resolveFieldCurrency` (objectui packages/i18n/src/currency.ts:32) still reads `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency` unconditionally, so the field faces of the Console this repo builds show the pre-fix behaviour until the pin bumps (release lane, AGENTS.md:297). The describe is true of objectui main and of every reader in this repo, and the card's own contract already takes objectui#10461 as the runtime; the body does not mention the pin. (2) objectui is not readable by REST from this session (403); the body's objectui claims were verified by anonymous git clone, and the cited a2f361b exists on objectui main after the fix. (3) objectui's resolver comment at main still says the spec calls the mode "user selectable"; it goes stale on merge, objectui-side. (4) Acceptance-note remainder confirmed at the head and correctly out of scope: `defaultCurrency` describe "Default or fixed"; `packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts:80`, `packages/spec/src/data/percent-scale.ts:14`, `packages/spec/liveness/dataset.json:114`. Same family, not listed in the body: `packages/spec/liveness/field.json:279` ("resolveFieldCurrency's ADR-0053 precedence chain", measured objectui @11c1e71e), `packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts:80` ("the ADR-0053 / percent-scale" chains), `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/datasets/chart-gallery.dataset.ts:44-48` (unconditioned `defaultCurrency` → tenant chain citing ADR-0053). All outside the card's pin scopes; for the closure card. (5) The body's data-api.mdx note that `label` / `format` / `percentScale` are "resolved server-side" on the cube face is a wider claim than currency; the source read agrees with the body (strategies push only `name`/`type`, enrichment runs only on `queryDataset`); not in scope. (6) The line-based-pin caveat on `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` and the three untouched `query-dataset.test.ts` titles belong to the Tier H / pin PR. (7) The PR is a Draft; the remainder (dashboards.md:304-308, the enumerating pin) is correctly excluded and the body says the PR does not close the card. (8) Nit: validation-rules.mdx:155's precision rule fails open for non-CLDR codes.

Skipped: "Console Pin Gate" (job condition `needs.filter.outputs.console != 'false'`, ci.yml:2337; no `.objectui-sha` / console-script change) and "Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)" (requires label `needs:pack-smoke`, pack-smoke-optin.yml:95-97). All 7 ruleset-required contexts success: TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, Build Core, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Lint & Repo Gates, Governed Surface Queue Guard. Closing keywords in the body: none (regex over close/fix/resolve forms + number: 0 hits; issue refs are #20126 as `Part of`, plus #20118 / #20119 / #20120 in prose); check-run "Part-of PR must not also close its card": success.
